instruction: I'm on a Ubuntu system. Please configure File Roller as the default archive manager.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets File Roller as the default archive manager. Uses custom getter get_default_archive_manager__901096b9 which checks the application/zip MIME type handler using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default archive manager includes 'file-roller.desktop'.
